shared_elements: monolithic anthropomorphic figure with blocky head above a columnar body
heavy projecting brow/chin ledge over the torso
low-relief linear carving covering the torso
schematic incised bands running down the front of the body
justification: Both depict a heavy schematic humanoid figure with an overhanging blocky head above a broad columnar torso, the torso surface covered by shallow low-relief linear motifs organised in vertical registers running downward from below the chin. The most specific difference is the content of that relief: B shows curvilinear, figural/emblematic devices including a prominent ring or disc on the body and arms wrapping the sides with a band at the waist, while A shows only rigid geometric chevron/herringbone bands with no recognisable figures or disc.
